node.title: Re^2: Perl as interactive shell?
node.author: LanX
node.doctext:
Thanks that's nice! :)

[METAMOD://IPC::Run] is certainly interesting, but it'd need a nicer syntax to be usable in a CLI.

[METAMOD://IPC::Run3::Shell] already looks much better, but I'd opt to use it primarily for non-standard executables which can't be implemented in Perl. (like with [HTTP://perlpowertools.com/|powertools] )

Cheers Rolf
